# Gianni Perugini

> Official portfolio and digital art store of Gianni Perugini, a creative director and digital media specialist working across digital art, photography, video and motion, and interface design.

## Primary pages

- [Home and artist profile](https://gianniperugini.com/): Professional overview, portfolio categories, biography, and contact information.
- [Digital Art Store](https://gianniperugini.com/archive.html): Watermarked previews, current USD pricing, personal-use collections, complete archives, and Payhip purchase links.
- [Portfolio](https://gianniperugini.com/portfolio.html): Earlier composites and promotional artwork, presented separately from products for sale.
- [Standard Commercial Licence](https://gianniperugini.com/commercial-licence.html): Authoritative commercial licence permissions and restrictions.

## Digital art products

- Individual wallpaper: one artwork in 4K desktop and mobile formats for personal use; checkout is being prepared.
- Collection: 12 mobile wallpapers from $4 USD, 12 4K desktop wallpapers from $4 USD, or all 24 files from $6 USD.
- Complete personal archive: 14 collections; mobile or desktop from $19 USD, or both formats from $29 USD.
- Complete commercial archive: 14 collections and 336 files from $79 USD under the Standard Commercial Licence.
- Prices marked with a plus sign are minimum pay-what-you-want prices. Buyers may enter a higher amount to support the artist.

## Important facts

- Products are digital downloads; no physical item is shipped.
- Desktop wallpapers are 3840 × 2160 JPG files.
- Mobile wallpapers are 1440 × 2560 JPG files and may use compositions different from the desktop versions.
- The website shows watermarked sales previews. Purchased download files are governed by the licence included with the applicable product.
- Payhip handles checkout and digital delivery.

For product availability, pricing, and licence terms, use the official pages linked above as the authoritative source.
